bullets.text: Minister Dr. R. Kumar inspected the rainwater removal operations in Velachery, emphasizing prompt administrative action.
Polimer News highlighted the flooding in Velachery where twenty motors were deployed, prompting a close watch on further measures.
Velachery residents told Deccan Chronicle that emergency pumping cannot substitute for a long-term, scientifically validated flood mitigation plan.
Dinamalar reported that clogged drains with two feet of debris caused severe waterlogging near the Velachery Vijay Nagar junction.
Heavy overnight rains led to a holiday for schools in Chennai, Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram, and Chengalpattu as announced by authorities.
Jaya Plus reported that knee-deep rainwater on Taramani main road caused severe hardship for motorists and traffic jams.
Corporation Commissioner Sameeran stated that 220 special camps are on standby and 1,212 complaints were received regarding rain damage.
The Greater Chennai Corporation reopened three flooded subways and cleared major bus routes as waterlogging eased across the city.
Heavy rains in Ponneri and Minjur flooded residential neighborhoods and surrounded the railway overbridge with rainwater.
Gummidipoondi MLA S. Vijayakumar inspected local flood relief operations and drainage clearing works following heavy downpours.
Collector S. Kavitha released the draft polling station list for the ten assembly constituencies in the Thiruvallur district.
Vultr and AMD announced a 20 MW AI supercluster in Chennai deploying AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs for enterprise and sovereign cloud needs.
MeitY directed Meta to review content algorithms and check misleading content on platforms like Instagram.
Tamil Nadu started IT procurement through ELCOT for the Phase-III paperless e-Courts project to modernise state courts.
Farmers' association members staged a road blockade across five places in Thiruvallur demanding full cooperative crop loan waivers.
Red Pix reported allegations regarding bribes taken from foreign companies for industrial and data centre approvals during the DMK tenure.
Chief Minister Vijay launched a public awareness campaign highlighting the critical importance of rainwater harvesting.
